meta.title: Elections
meta.description: Countdown to the 10 August 2027 General Election, key dates, how to check your voter registration, and a voter checklist.

hero.title: Election day: Tuesday 10 August 2027
hero.lead: Polls open at 6:00 am. Check your registration now, and plan your day.

countdown.title: Time to polls opening
countdown.note: Dates and rules come from the Independent Electoral and Boundaries Commission. Always confirm on iebc.or.ke.

dates.title: Key dates
dates.campaign-closes: Campaign period closes (48 hours before polling)

checklist.title: Voter checklist
checklist.lead: Tick these off before election day.

items.register: Confirm I am on the voters' register (use IEBC's verification service).
items.station: Know my polling station and how I will get there.
items.id: Have my national ID card or passport ready: the document I registered with.
items.early: Plan to arrive early. Polls open at 6:00 am.
items.family: Help one family member or neighbour check their registration too.
